# `fnox proxy`

- **Usage:** `fnox proxy <SUBCOMMAND>`

Broker credentials into destination-scoped HTTPS requests

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Subcommands

- [`fnox proxy rules`](/cli/proxy/rules.md)
- [`fnox proxy run [COMMAND]…`](/cli/proxy/run.md)

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Configure destination rules before launching a command. The proxy controls credential injection; it is not an operating-system sandbox.

```sh
fnox proxy rules
fnox proxy run -- node agent.js
```
